title: 第13章 三条对策第14章 暖心
lines: 宁宸跟着全公公来到上次的包厢。
一进门，发现除了天玄，还有一个缺了一条腿的老人。
宁宸虽然第一次见，但第一时间就猜出了对方的身份，陈老将军。
“大叔，又见面了？”
宁宸上前，作揖行礼。
然后对陈老将军郑重地行了一礼，“小民蓝星，见过陈老将军！”
虽然是第一次见，但宁宸曾为军人，所以他对这位戎马一生的老将军特别尊重。
“你就是蓝星？”
陈老将军有些激动，上下打量着宁宸，旋即皱眉：“天气寒冷，怎么穿的如此单薄？”
宁宸苦笑，道：“一言难尽！”
见宁宸不想多说，陈老将军也没追问，而是好奇地问道：“你怎么知道老夫的身份？莫非以前见过？”
“小民是第一次见陈老将军，但陈老将军的英雄事迹，我可是从小听到大，心中的敬仰之情，犹如滔滔江水连绵不绝。”
宁宸脸不红心不跳地一记猛烈的马屁拍了过去。
这位可是陈老将军，连当今陛下都对他礼遇有加，如果能抱上他的大腿，好处多多。
陈老将军对宁宸的马屁很受用，发出一阵爽朗的笑声，中气十足。
“老夫还要谢谢你的那首词，英雄出少年啊，这般年纪，竟能写出这种旷世之作，了不得！”
陈老将军对宁宸的印象很好，不吝夸赞。
宁宸谦虚地说道：“陈老将军谬赞了，小民愧不敢当...跟您比，犹如萤火对皓月。”
“哈哈哈...这小子，嘴真甜！而且面对老夫，不卑不亢，要是老夫年轻时遇到你，定要带你上战场。”
宁宸急忙道：“其实小民从小的梦想就是身披戎装，上场杀敌，为国争锋...为此我曾苦读兵书，研习兵法。”
这话宁宸都没说谎，他很怀念跟战友们并肩杀敌的日子。
“你还研习过兵法？”
玄帝有些惊讶。
宁宸谦虚地说道：“略有研究而已。”
“那我可得考考你，看你是不是吹牛？”
玄帝笑着说道，他也想看看，宁宸除了诗词歌赋，会不会在别的地方给他带来惊喜？
宁宸笑着说道：“大叔...你这是为难我啊？”
“怎么，怕了？”
“倒也不是怕...若是我说的不对，大叔就当听一乐，千万别影响咱们做买卖。”
玄帝嘴角微微抽搐，原来是担心自己不买他的诗词？
不过这小子怎么回事？天寒地冻，穿的如此单薄？
刚才陈老将军问的时候，这小子一脸愤懑苦涩，看来他身上肯定发生了什么事？
看来回头得让人查查。
“蓝天，最近陀罗国的骑兵，屡屡骚扰我大玄边境，劫掠百姓...虽然我们已经派兵驻守，但陀罗国以游牧为生，他们的战马速度很快，来无影去无踪。”
“所以，等我大玄的将士得到消息赶到的时候，陀罗国的兵马已经撤了...你可有办法？”
宁天摇头。
天玄有些失望，“没有办法吗？”
“不是没有办法，是不能说...大叔，这可是朝政，妄论朝政，是要杀头的。”
content_en:
Ning Chen followed Eunuch Quan to the last box.
As soon as he entered the door, he found that besides Tianxuan, there was also an old man who was missing a leg.
Although Ning Chen met him for the first time, he immediately guessed the identity of the other party, General Chen.
"Uncle, see you again?"
Ning Chen stepped forward and bowed in salute.
Then he solemnly saluted Old General Chen, "Little citizen Lanxing, I have met Old General Chen!"
Although it was his first time meeting him, Ning Chen had been a soldier, so he had special respect for this veteran general who had spent his entire life in the military.
"Are you Blue Star?"
Old General Chen was a little excited. He looked Ning Chen up and down, and then frowned: "It's cold, why are you wearing such thin clothes?"
Ning Chen smiled bitterly and said, "It's hard to explain in just one word!"
Seeing that Ning Chen didn't want to say more, General Chen didn't ask further questions, but asked curiously: "How do you know my identity? Have you met him before?"
"This is my first time to meet General Chen, but I have heard about General Chen's heroic deeds since I was a child, and the admiration in my heart is like an endless river."
Ning Chen's face didn't turn red and his heart didn't beat, and he slapped her in the face with a fierce flattery.
This is Old General Chen, and even His Majesty treats him with great courtesy. If you can hug him, there will be many benefits.
Old General Chen was very pleased with Ning Chen's flattery and let out a hearty laugh, full of energy.
"I would also like to thank you for your poem. A hero comes from a young age. It's amazing that someone at such an age can write such a masterpiece!"
General Chen had a very good impression of Ning Chen and praised him generously.
Ning Chen said humbly: "Old General Chen is so complimentary. I don't deserve it. Comparing me to you is like a firefly to a bright moon."
"Hahaha... This boy has such a sweet mouth! And he is neither humble nor arrogant in front of me. If I meet you when I am young, I will definitely take you to the battlefield."
Ning Chen hurriedly said: "Actually, the dream of a commoner since childhood is to wear a military uniform, go out on the field to kill the enemy, and compete for the country... For this reason, I have studied military books and studied the art of war."
Ning Chen didn't lie. He missed the days of fighting the enemy side by side with his comrades.
"Have you ever studied the art of war?"
Emperor Xuan was a little surprised.
Ning Chen said modestly: "It's just a little research."
"Then I have to test you to see if you are bragging?"
Emperor Xuan said with a smile that he also wanted to see if Ning Chen would surprise him in other places besides poetry and songs.
Ning Chen smiled and said: "Uncle...are you making things difficult for me?"
"What, are you scared?"
"It's not that I'm afraid...if what I say is wrong, uncle will just listen to it and don't affect our business."
Emperor Xuan's mouth twitched slightly. Was he worried that he wouldn't buy his poems?
But what happened to this kid? It's freezing cold and you're wearing such thin clothes?
When General Chen asked just now, the boy had an angry and bitter look on his face. It seemed like something must have happened to him?
Looks like I need to have someone check it out later.
"Lantian, recently the cavalry of the Tuoluo Kingdom have repeatedly harassed our Daxuan border and robbed the people... Although we have sent troops to garrison, the Tuoluo Kingdom makes a living as nomads. Their horses are very fast and come and go without a trace."
"So, by the time my Daxuan soldiers get the news and arrive, Tuoluo Kingdom's troops have already withdrawn... Do you have any idea?"
Ning Tian shook his head.
Tianxuan was a little disappointed, "Is there no way?"
"It's not that there is no way, but it can't be said...Uncle, this is government affairs. If you talk about government affairs, you will be beheaded."
